# kentik-synthetics_agent_alerts (Data Source)

Agent offline alerts, optionally limited to some agents.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Alerts of two agents; omit agent_ids to list all agent alerts.
data "kentik-synthetics_agent_alerts" "office" {
  agent_ids = ["968", "1717"]
}

output "office_alert_ids" {
  value = [for a in data.kentik-synthetics_agent_alerts.office.items : a.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `agent_ids` (Set of String) Only return alerts of these agents. All alerts when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `items` (List of Object) Agent alerts. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `agent_id` (String)
- `agent_name` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `notification_channel_ids` (Set of String)
- `threshold_seconds` (Number)
